goal: Prevent address queries from returning fewer addresses than requested when many peers are banned
Avoid leaking banlist size to external peers by consistently returning the requested number of addresses
agreement: Disputed approach: blocking objections oppose the predicate design as overengineered (fjahr, Bicaru20)
Concept support for filtering during selection to avoid leaking banlist sizes (mzumsande, sipa)
Unaddressed objection: retaining banned addresses in AddrMan causes slot competition (ajtowns)
Unaddressed suggestion to unify all selection logic inside the callback (sipa)
Unaddressed objection: tests do not verify that capped queries avoid underfill (frankomosh)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because underfilled address responses only occur when large numbers of peers are banned or discouraged
P3 because the leak of banlist size to peers is subtle and address starvation is uncommon
